item.title: Not a mistrial, yet. Clancy's lawyer asks for emergency appeal in her murder trial
item.description: The judge was on the verge of declaring a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case. Then her defense attorney requested time to seek an emergency stay from the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts.

item.title: Dry eyes are common in women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore them
item.description: Research suggests that around half of all women in the menopausal transition years experience symptoms, like red, watery or gritty-feeling eyes. Hormonal shifts play a role, as do many other factors.

item.title: Whatever happened to ... children infected with HIV due to failures in healthcare?
item.description: For years, Pakistan has seen cases of children infected with HIV due to unsafe treatment in clinics and hospitals. A current outbreak numbers hundreds of cases. Why does this problem keep occurring?

item.title: They live by a shrine to a saint. Why are their homes being demolished?
item.description: The neighborhood is a pilgrimage site, with a shrine to the Sufi saint known as Bari Imam. In the past year, hundreds of homes of the working poor were razed. Residents fear more will be demolished.
